description: This Java class 'TestStringGenerator' provides utility methods to generate test strings of a specified byte size, primarily for testing purposes. It includes a method to create a string composed of repeated Unicode characters and 'x' characters to reach the desired byte length.

classes.name: TestStringGenerator
classes.description: Final utility class with static methods for generating test strings of specified byte size.

methods.name: createStringOfBytes
methods.description: Generates a string of the specified byte length by repeating a Unicode string and appending 'x' characters as necessary.

methods.name: repeat
methods.description: Private helper method that creates a stream of repeated strings.
